name: Unicameral Bone Cyst
definition: Benign fluid-filled bone cavity usually in the proximal humerus or femur of children/adolescents, often discovered after pathological fracture.

investigations.principle: Radiographs are usually diagnostic; MRI/CT is selective.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Injection, curettage or fixation is selected for recurrent/high-risk lesions.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi lesion phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Benign fluid-filled bone cavity usually in the proximal humerus or femur of children/adolescents, often discovered after pathological fracture.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for rapidly progressive weakness, respiratory/swallowing compromise, major vascular symptoms, suspected malignancy/pathological fracture, severe systemic illness or other listed red flags.
